Directions(Q.1-5): Answer the questions based on the information given below:

immediately below of flat 1 of floor 2, which is immediately below of flat 1 of floor 3 and so  
on, similarly for flat 2.  
Note: If a person lives above the other person, then flat type of both may or may not be  
same.

bottommost floor. Q lives one floor above V. U lives to the south east of T. O lives to the  
north east of W. R lives above P such that they live in same type of flat (different floors).

Ajay does not live on an even numbered floor and in an even numbered flat. Rohan lives

numbered flat which is to the left of Ashish's. Sanjay and Yuvraj both live in the flat which  
is numbered 1. Ajay lives on the floor just above Rohan’s floor and Yuvraj lives on one of  
the floors on which one flat is vacant.

(Q.16-20):  
Solution:  
(i) U lives in Flat 1.  
(ii) V lives one floor below U.  
(iii) O and U live in the same type of flat.  
(iv) T, who lives adjacent to M, lives two floors above O.  
There will be two cases:  
Case 1.  
If T lives in Flat 1 of floor no. 5, then O lives at Flat 1 of floor no. 3.  
M lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 5.  
We will need two consecutive flats for U and V. So, U and V live at floor no. 2 and 1  
respectively of Flat 1.  
Case 2.  
If T lives in Flat 1 of floor no. 3, then O lives at Flat 1 of floor no. 1.  
M lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 3.  
We will need two consecutive flats for U and V. So, U and V live at floor no. 5 and 4  
respectively of Flat 1.

Case 1.  
There will be gap of one floor between S and P. So, P lives in Flat 1 of floor no. 2 and S  
lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 2.  
As Q lives one floor above R. It means there will be no gap between Q and R. If Q and R  
lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 4 and 3 respectively. Then N lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 1. But this  
case will get discarded as N doesn’t live adjacent to V.  
Case 2.  
There will be gap of one floor between S and P. So, P lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 4 and S  
lives in Flat 1 of floor no. 2.  
As Q lives one floor above R. It means there will be no gap between Q and R. If Q and R  
lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 2 and 1 respectively. Then N lives in Flat 2 of floor no. 5.
